GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-03-18T03:38:36Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Swoole not supported HTTP Client SSL SNI? (ssl handshake failure)
Description: Swoole not supported HTTP_Client SSL SNI?

Test script:

```
<?php

$domain = 'intoconsultoria.com';
$ip = gethostbyname($domain);

$cli = new swoole_http_client($ip, 443, true);

$cli->set(array(
    'timeout' => -1,
    'debug_mode'=> 1,
));

$cli->setHeaders([
    'Host' => $domain,
    'cache-control' => 'no-cache',
]);

$cli->get('/', function ($cli) {
    print_r($cli->body);
});

?>
```

Output: WARNING swSSL_connect: SSL_connect() failed. Error: (null)[1]

Test SSL with openssl (without SNI):
```
shell: openssl s_client -connect intoconsultoria.com:443

output: SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert internal error:ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:1399:SSL alert number 80
```

Test SSL with openssl (with SNI):

```
shell: openssl s_client -connect intoconsultoria.com:443 -servername intoconsultoria.com

Ssl test successfully.
```

How to make swoole work properly with SSL-SNI?
